correctness.rationale: By S^3={0}, all S^2 output elements annihilate and are isolated in Wang–Yin–Wang N(S); its unary relation is total. Homomorphic equivalence reduces finite duality to a loopless product graph on at most three atoms. For transitive digraphs, rank-coloring yields hom equivalence to T2/T3, whose finite obstruction is a directed path of length 2/3. For every nontransitive 2/3-vertex graph, the four exhaustive cases (mutual edge without mutual triangle, mutual triangle, oriented 3-cycle, oriented P2) admit unbounded induced-critical obstructions (bidirected odd cycles, odd wheels, directed cycles of length nonmultiple3, alternating odd signed cycles). This proves no finite duality, not just a finite experiment. At order5 only one output plus three atoms, or two outputs plus two atoms, can occur; Burnside and complete table relabelings give 15+1=16, and exactly four transitive cases. Order6 example explicitly hom-equivalent to T3. Independent Python standard-library exhaustive semigroup and finite-witness checks returned VERIFY_OK.

value.rationale: Finite equational basability of full power semirings is a natural nontrivial invariant for small nilpotent semigroups. The result delivers a complete non-arbitrary natural-order stratum (all order-five cubic-nilpotent semigroups with every element square zero), its exact 16/4 count under true semigroup isomorphism, an elementary graph criterion avoiding a general-purpose CSP dismantling algorithm, and an order-six boundary counterexample. The value derives from a complete small classification and sharp structural cutoff, not from code or novelty claims alone.
